answer: A hardware attestation root binds each agent to a unique silicon identity, so a sybil cluster cannot thread multiple fake personas through one physical device without breaking the attestation chain. Every signed Modbus or DNP3 control signal is cross-checked against a shared contingency ledger, letting honest peers detect the reef of cloned identities before they seize quorum. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
